sectionBreakdown.fromTo: Trailhead to the basin camp below the glacier
Basin camp up the Sherpa Glacier to the summit
Back down the glacier and out to the trailhead

before.recommendedStart: Alpine (pre-dawn) start from high camp given the length of the summit day, which includes off-trail travel, roped glacier crossing, and a belayed moat crossing before and after the summit

after.recommendedStart: Alpine (pre-dawn) start from high camp given the length of the summit day, which includes off-trail travel, roped glacier crossing, and a belayed moat crossing before and after the summit

sectionBreakdown.fromTo: Camp up the Dark Glacier to the summit
Summit back to camp, then out to the trailhead

sectionBreakdown.note: Leave the Stuart Lake Trail below Colchuck junction and follow Mountaineer Creek into the basin below the glacier, carrying a full ice rack.
sectionBreakdown.fromTo: Approach to a bivy near the glacier

sectionBreakdown.note: A pre-dawn start crosses the glacier and exits the crux ice/cornice while conditions are firm. The route tops out on the ridge below the false summit, and the Sherpa Glacier is descended back …
sectionBreakdown.fromTo: Climb the Ice Cliff Glacier to the summit, descend the Sherpa Glacier
